description.en: Codebase-native delivery board with stage pipeline, handoff audit trail, soft WIP limits, weekly Markdown report, and a local kanban + calendar Timeline UI. Works as a DSH plugin or standalone via npx.
description.zh: 写在代码仓库里的交付看板：阶段流水线、交接审计、软 WIP、周报 Markdown，以及本地看板与日历 Timeline。可作为 DSH 插件，也可通过 npx 独立运行。
